description: This file defines a base class for a device in a testing framework, specifically for the prplMesh project. It implements device interaction methods such as executing commands, checking device status, and log handling, and includes a custom exception class.

classes.name: CommandError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when command execution fails.

classes.name: PrplMeshBase
classes.description: An abstract device class for prplMesh, extending linux.LinuxDevice, with methods for executing commands, status checks, log copying, and device management.

methods.name: _run_shell_cmd(self, cmd: str = "", args: list = None, timeout: int = 30, env: Dict[str, str] = None)
methods.description: Executes a shell command with arguments on the device, logs output, and raises an exception if execution fails.

methods.name: check_status(self)
methods.description: Indicates whether the device is operational; currently always returns True.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the device connection and copies logs.

methods.name: isalive(self)
methods.description: Checks if the device is alive and accessible; currently not implemented.

methods.name: touch(self)
methods.description: Keeps the device connection active; currently not implemented.

methods.name: ALEntity get_active_entity(self)
methods.description: Returns the active ALEntityDocker instance based on device role.

methods.name: copy_logs(self)
methods.description: Copies logs from the device; currently not implemented.

ctags.name: _run_shell_cmd
ctags.pattern: /^    def _run_shell_cmd(self, cmd: str = "", args: list = None, timeout: int = 30,$/
ctags.signature: (self, cmd: str = "", args: list = None, timeout: int = 30, env: Dict[str, str] = None)
